title: The IaC rename: let the DNS role trust SovereignWebsite__IaC
why: SovereignWebsite__Factory becomes SovereignWebsite__IaC (Dinis Cruz, 22 Nov 2026). DNS apply assumes the role sovereignwebsite-factory-dns through GitHub OIDC, and GitHub's subject names the repository, so the trust policy must also accept the new name before the rename merges. Plan agreed with factory.c (policy/proposals/2026-11-22__iac-rename-plan.md on the Factory).
keep: every existing subject; the Factory lines come out in a later plan, after DNS apply has run under the new name
never: any other statement, condition, principal or the role's permissions
